outcome: stress levels (measured by questionnaires and cortisol levels)
cohort: 124 low-risk primiparous women recruited during latent phase of labor after epidural anesthesia
finding: Listening to music during labor, improves the likelihood of primiparas to have a vaginal delivery regardless of stress level.
mod_finding: Women listening to music during labor had a significantly higher rate of spontaneous vaginal delivery compared to the non-music group.
